notes.subject: עדי
notes.rationale: Tupela pasin: 'kam bek long mi' (preposition עד) o 'oi, ol man bilong mi' (krai bilong profet) — mipela i usim namba wan pasin.

notes.subject: לבבכם
notes.rationale: לב em i bel — tingting na laik, i no hat.

notes.subject: שובו
notes.rationale: Tok bilong kalim ol man ol i kam bek — kal bilong olgeta manmeri.

notes.subject: שובו
notes.rationale: Kal stret long ol man bilong Zion — narapela nem bilong 'ol man bilong mi'.

translation: Na yet nau — Yahwe i tok — senis na kam bek long mi, ol man bilong mi, wantaim bel bilong yupela olgeta, na wantaim fastim kaikai, na wantaim krai, na wantaim krai bilong ol i dai.

tokens.gloss: long mi, ol man bilong mi
na wantaim krai bilong ol i dai
